texts.preamble: M/S Parmatma Allied Feed Co. Pvt. Ltd. vs The State Of Bihar Through The ... on 17 April, 2015 Author: Vikash Jain Bench: Vikash Jain In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna Criminal Writ Jurisdiction Case No.331 of 2015 ====================================================== M/s Parmatma Allied Feed Co. Pvt. Ltd. .... .... Peti Versus The State of Bihar through the Collector, Samastipur & Ors .... .... Respond ===================================================== = Appearance : For the Petitioner : Mr. Alok Kumar Agrawal, Advocate For the Respondents : Mr. A.P.Singh (Sc-15) ====================================================== Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Vikash Jain Oral Order
texts.facts: The remaining reliefs including the prayer for quashing of the first information report are not pressed and learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the same, which is permitted. 2. It has been submitted that the respondents have illegally sealed a part of the factory premises, pursuant to the institution of the FIR, without there being any authority to seal the factory premises either under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 nor under the Code of Criminal Procedure.
texts.arguments: At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner limits the relief sought for in the present writ petition only to paragraph 1(i) of the writ petition with regard to unsealing a part of the factory premises of the petitioner-Company which was sealed.
texts.petitioner_arguments: At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner limits the relief sought for in the present writ petition only to paragraph 1(i) of the writ petition with regard to unsealing a part of the factory premises of the petitioner-Company which was sealed.
